name: Xyrun-Jed
description: The last emperor of the loxodon on Arcavios, who hid his city Zantafar rather than see it conquered.

description_citations.text: "Xyrun-Jed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quint finds an enormous golden statue of a loxodon in a chamber.
timeline.quote: an enormous golden statue of a loxodon in repose

citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zantafar falls or is hidden in the last emperor's time, dispersing the loxodon across the Vastlands.
timeline.quote: Xyrun-Jed’s actions resulted in the dispersion of the loxodon across the Vastlands.

citation.text: "Xyrun-Jed", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The last loxodon emperor, credited with the Canticle of Jed and with the fall of Zantafar.

citation.text: "The Mentor" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2021.
